name: Balearic Aesthetic
summary: The Balearic aesthetic is a visual and cultural style that originated in the late 1980s on the island of Ibiza.
description: The Balearic aesthetic is a visual and cultural style that originated in the late 1980s on the island of Ibiza. It is characterized by a mood of unhurried, sun-drenched euphoria and bohemian freedom, which is rooted in the eclectic, chilled-out nature of the Balearic Beat music genre. [ 1 ] The aesthetic is characterized by its soft sun-bleached color palette and an emphasis on the natural environment (particularly sunsets and beaches) transcending any one fashion or genre to embody a lifestyle of spontaneous bliss. [ 1 ]
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Chilling out, euphoria, free spirit, fun, spontaneity, unhurried pace
